visible_goal: Build and solve the specified 10 x 10 x 100 mm isotropic steel solid cantilever under a single -100 N point force; report signed tip UY/U2 and the solver-branch-defined final maximum von Mises stress.
selection_reason: 3D cantilever statics is a direct equivalent in the alternate commercial FEA tool.

tip_displacement.definition: Signed final global Y displacement at the unique loaded point (5,10,100)
tip_displacement.abaqus_extraction: U2 at the loaded node in the final static ODB frame
tip_displacement.ansys_extraction: UY at the loaded node in SET,LAST

max_mises.definition: Final-result maximum equivalent von Mises stress over the beam structural-solid elements
max_mises.abaqus_extraction: maximum integration-point S.Mises in the final ODB frame
max_mises.ansys_extraction: maximum saved nodally averaged S,EQV over beam solid corner nodes in SET,LAST

equivalent_modeling.fixed_boundary: all three translations on exactly the complete Z=0 face
equivalent_modeling.load: exactly one FY=-100 N concentrated load at (5,10,100)
equivalent_modeling.material: isotropic linear elastic E=210000 MPa, nu=0.3
equivalent_modeling.mesh: approximately 5 mm global target with a connected 3D structural-solid mesh
